audit.why: Tangle-Barbs (12s at rank 1) is her only setup and grows through units — sidestepping behind minions is wrong advice for E specifically (it passes through and grows); it is dodged by lateral movement. Kept the minion-blocking advice only for Q blooms. W stun both interrupts Pop Blossom's preparation and breaks Inherent Glamour disguise.
